ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all Gies Business Administration majors on Monday, November 14, 2022 and to all other Gies majors and Informatics Minors on Monday, November 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 20, 2023 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Strategy, Innovation & Entrep major(s) or minor(s).
